label: provision-mise
argv:
set -eu
test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 || { echo "pinned mise hash is for linux-arm64" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
curl -fsSL -o "$HOME/.local/bin/mise.download" https://github.com/jdx/mise/releases/download/v2026.10.3/mise-v2026.10.3-linux-arm64

chmod 755 "$HOME/.local/bin/mise.download" && mv "$HOME/.local/bin/mise.download" "$HOME/.local/bin/mise"
"$HOME/.local/bin/mise" --version | grep -q "^2026.10.3 "
